Choose and validate API-side SQL deadlines; this campaign measured the client timeout and recovery, not a guaranteed server deadline.
Power-loss/temp-file crash recovery and object-storage reconciliation need separate experiments.
Dependency reachability/remediation remains in SEC-09; passing security tests is not clearance of all advisory findings.
DINO main is a named ref, not a supply-chain commit pin. Preserve/check cached code and model digests for future experiments.
